verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing documents billing a customer in a currency other than their default (multi-currency customers), which covers the local-currency billing core. The evidence does not show per-currency price points or consolidated reporting converted to a home currency; the product catalog and CSV export are generic and say nothing about currency handling. missing for 10: per-currency price points on products/prices, consolidated home-currency reporting/FX conversion, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can bill customers in their local currency with per-currency price points and consolidated reporting in my home currency

citations.quote: you can bill the same Customer using a different currency than what's set as their default currency
